mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year indicates inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer demand, which is a positive signal for the economy and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a strong supply side of the economy, which is positive for corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5%, it indicates a restrictive monetary policy, which is negative for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 5% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a strong labor market, which is positive for consumer spending and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases, but S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, which is negative for the economy and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS decreases and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1%, it indicates an accommodative monetary policy, which is positive for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS < 1% and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the triggered instances.
